cases.title: Real CLI validates and creates a multilingual sidecar
cases.requirement: The explicit CLI handles Chinese, Japanese, currency symbols, emoji, spaces, and canonical UTF-8 output.
cases.expected: validate succeeds and project creates one external sidecar

cases.title: Source and structure violations fail closed
cases.requirement: Unknown IDs, source drift, malformed UTF-8, incompatible status, and recomputed-hash tampering are rejected.
cases.expected: all invalid inputs are rejected without a sidecar write

cases.title: Candidate identity binds the complete implementation file set
cases.requirement: The declared candidate SHA-256 is computed from the ordered path and SHA-256 list of every implementation file.
cases.runner: PowerShell Get-FileHash SHA256 over the six declared implementation files

cases.title: Append-only sidecar boundary preserves summary-v1
cases.requirement: Identical reruns are idempotent, different bytes cannot replace an existing sidecar, and archive-root output is rejected.
cases.expected: summary-v1 hash is unchanged and all overwrite or archive-root attempts fail closed

historical_failures.description: Redirected Windows CLI output previously inherited a legacy console encoding and broke Japanese currency and multilingual paths.
Adding fields to old summary records previously changed federation identities, so the new representation must remain a separate sidecar.
